mapper.select: select c1.c_name as miCpyName, pro.p_name as pName, sec.sec_name as secName, con.con_name as conName, gt.Task_Text as taskText, mn.* from memoir_info mn left join pre_project pro on pro.p_id = mn.p_id left join sec_info sec on sec.sec_id = mn.sec_id left join con_contract con on con.con_id = mn.con_id left join Gantt_Tasks gt on gt.task_id = mn.task_id left join Sys_Company c1 on c1.c_id = mn.mi_cpy where mn.id = #{id}
